english.title: Use a motor vehicle on a road when the vehicle hazard warning signal device was misused
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on which a hazard warning signal device was used in a manner other than specified in regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H2580 and H2581.
(iii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(iv) Item 5 of the table attached to regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 provides that a hazard warning signal device may be lawfully used in the following circumstances:-
(a) to warn persons using the road of a temporary obstruction when the vehicle is at rest; or
(b) on a motorway or unrestricted dual-carriageway, to warn following drivers of a need to slow down due to a temporary obstruction ahead; or
(c) in the case of a bus, to summon assistance for the driver or any person acting as a conductor or inspector on the vehicle or
(d) in the case of a bus to which prescribed signs are fitted as described in sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of regulation 17A(1), when the vehicle is stationary and children under the age of 16 years are entering or leaving, or are about to enter or leave, or have just left the vehicle.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when the hazard warning device fitted to it was used **(..SPECIFY CIRCUMSTANCES IN WHICH DEVICE USED..). This was not a use specified by regulation 27 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989.
